authority_boundary: This compilation validates and summarizes Council records. It does not approve, merge, activate, ratify, or certify.
conditions: Enforce GI-STEWARD-0002 exactly: mandatory routine reviewers remain empty; jimsteeg is contacted only for exact recovery or separately named optional review.
Freeze and validate a closed classifier before runtime change; unknown, mixed, generator-affecting, dependency-widening, or invalid states select conservative fanout.
Retain all current required pre-merge checks and emit exact-SHA protected-target readback for every protected merge.
Replace generic fixed-delay work with event-driven readback plus scheduled recovery and manual escalation; retain a timer only for an enumerated risk contract.
Publish append-only classification, execution, readback, recovery, incident, and supersession evidence without treating not-applicable as passed.
Validate hostile stale-head, mixed-path, generator, lost-event, duplicate-event, replay, hold, ruleset-drift, and unauthorized-reviewer cases.

Require separate authenticated Human Steward disposition wherever effective authority reserves it; automation may prepare and validate but not approve, merge its own work, activate, ratify, certify, impersonate, or expand permissions.
Measure routine jimsteeg requests, human actions, fixed-delay jobs, false-lightweight classifications, incidents, and handling time; preserve rollback.
